lines: Olave's workload is steady. He saw 10.3 targets a game over his last 3 games, a 29% share of the team's targets.
He scored 14.0 PPR points a game over the last 3 games, down from 16.7 on the season, with fewer catches and yards per game.
Week 12 is at CIN, which allows the 24th-most PPR points per game to WRs. The coach said defenses are taking Olave away.
